# SHINES Headlight Restoration

> SHINES restores foggy, yellowed, and oxidized headlights to clear, like-new condition using a professional strip-and-recoat process: the failed factory UV layer is removed completely, then replaced with an OEM-grade UV hard coat that is fully cured in-shop before handover. Based in Ingelmunster, Belgium, with mobile service across Belgium and mail-in service across Europe.

## What SHINES does

Exterior light lens restoration for cars — headlights, fog lights, and tail lights: removes oxidation, yellowing, haze, UV damage, and scratches from polycarbonate and acrylic lenses, then seals them with a UV-cured hard coat so clarity lasts years. Restoration is a fraction of the cost of replacing headlight units (new OEM assemblies often cost €300–€800+ per side). SHINES does nothing else — it is a dedicated headlight restoration specialist, positioned as the premium option in the Belgian market.

## Pricing (21% BTW included)

- Single headlight restoration: from €109
- Pair (both headlights): from €189 — most popular, saves €29 vs two singles
- Mail-in restoration (Europe): from €214 per pair, handling included (excl. shipping both ways)
- Add-on fog lights (pair): from €49 in the same booking
- Add-on tail lights (pair): from €79 in the same booking
- Mobile "we come to you" (Belgium and nearby FR/NL): €25 service fee + travel from €59 (includes up to 25 km one-way)
- Price modifiers: headlight size (standard / large wraparound +€25 / complex +€45) and lens condition (light haze / heavy oxidation +€20 / severe damage +€40)
- Mail-in return shipping is a fixed price per country: Belgium €15, Netherlands/Germany/France/Luxembourg €25, United Kingdom and other countries €55 — shown at booking, paid before dispatch
- 1-year clarity guarantee on all restorations

## Service options

- Garage visit: drop off at the workshop in Ingelmunster (free on-site parking). Turnaround about 30–60 minutes per light, 45–90 minutes for both — the coating is fully cured before you drive away.
- Mobile service (Belgium and nearby France/Netherlands, up to 75 km one-way): SHINES travels to you; both headlights only.
- Mail-in service (Europe): ship your headlights to the workshop; turnaround about 3–5 business days plus shipping. Intake is documented on video and photos.

## Common questions

- How much does headlight restoration cost? From €109 for one headlight and from €189 for a pair, 21% BTW included. The exact price is shown instantly on the booking page — no quote calls.
- How long does it take? About 30–60 minutes per headlight at the garage; mail-in is about 3–5 business days plus shipping.
- How long do results last? SHINES strips the failed factory layer and applies an OEM-grade UV-cured hard coat, backed by a 1-year clarity guarantee; results typically last years, unlike DIY kits that haze again within months.
- Is restoration cheaper than replacing headlights? Yes — restoration from €189 per pair vs €300–€800+ per side for new OEM assemblies.
- Do you also do fog lights and tail lights? Yes, both can be added to any headlight booking: fog lights from €49 per pair, tail lights from €79 per pair.
- Do you come to me? Yes, mobile service covers Belgium and nearby France/Netherlands (both headlights only); elsewhere in Europe use mail-in.
- Can I ship my headlights? Yes, mail-in service covers Europe from €214 per pair, with fixed return shipping per country shown at booking.
- Why is SHINES more expensive than a detailer? SHINES is a specialist that only does light lens restoration: full strip of the failed coating, OEM-grade UV hard coat, in-shop curing before handover, documented inspection, and a clarity guarantee — not a temporary polish.
